name: AI Working Loader
summary: A small status pill, card or row shows the AI at work: a spinner or sparkle turns, a shimmer sweeps the label, and the status words cycle through what it is doing. It is a short bridge between a request and its result that makes the wait feel purposeful.
when_to_use: Between a sent prompt and the generated result
Showing the AI reaching into several connected tools or sources
A brief beat that builds anticipation before a reveal

slots.name: status_label
slots.what: a short present-tense action, like designing or scanning

slots.name: status_cycle
slots.what: a few alternative status labels to swap through

slots.name: working_icon
slots.what: a sparkle, spinner ring, avatar or pulsing dots that move while working

slots.name: source_icons
slots.what: app icons paired with each status row or label

slots.name: backdrop
slots.what: the blurred or dimmed context behind the loader, or a living visual such as a rotating globe

slots.name: result_view
slots.what: the finished output the loader resolves into

steps: The request card collapses or the view cuts to a compact status pill or card
The working icon starts moving: a spin, pulse or animated face
A light shimmer sweeps across the label while the status words cycle or new status rows append
Finished rows dim to a muted colour to read as done
The loader blurs or fades away and the result resolves in, or the scene hard-cuts to it

build.gsap: One timeline per scene. Loop the icon with a repeating linear rotation or a yoyo scale pulse on the dots. Run the shimmer as a repeating tween of a gradient mask position across the label (linear or sine.inOut). Swap status labels with short opacity crossfades on a fixed interval, or append each new status row with a left-to-right mask reveal (power2.out) and then tween the previous row's colour to grey. End with a blur-and-fade out of the loader overlapping a blur-in of the result view.
build.remotion: One Sequence for the loader and one for the result. Drive rotation and shimmer from the frame number with interpolate() and modulo for looping. Each status label or row is its own Sequence with a short interpolate() fade or mask reveal; dimming is interpolate() on colour. The exit crossfades blur and opacity between the two Sequences; springs are not needed.

sound: No typical sound. The only measured cues are labelled unsure, scattered through the middle of the scene.
caveats: No measured motion events or patterns, so none are listed; the descriptions suggest input text cycle and blur crossfade.
Few shots, and the loader style varies: status pill, status rows, shimmer over a card, spinner card.
No reliable sound: every measured cue is labelled unsure.
